title: Huskies fall to Spartans 3-1 in section quarters to end season - NewsBreak
text:
Owatonna
Huskies fall to Spartans 3-1 in section quarters to end season
By LUCAS DITTMER,
1 days agoThe first half of Owatonna girls soccer’s playoff game against the Rochester Mayo Spartans had something that the Huskies have been great at all season: defense.
The Huskies and Spartans faced off in Rochester in the Section 1AAA quarterfinals on Tuesday evening, as the Spartans were the No. 4 seed in the section and Owatonna was the No. 5 seed. After a 0-0 tie at halftime, Mayo ended up winning 3-1 to advance to the semifinals while Owatonna was eliminated.
Owatonna looked to get revenge on the Spartans after they lost to Mayo on the same field in the regular season. They lost 2-0 after beating them in last season’s regular season finale 2-1 at home. This was the Huskies’ third time in Rochester this season, as they also played Century on the road in their first section game of the regular season.
This was Owatonna’s first playoff game against a Rochester team in two years, as they did not face the Spartans, JM Rockets, or Century Panthers last year in their section runner-up run. The last time they faced a Rochester team in the 1AAA playoffs was 2023, where they lost to the Panthers 1-0 in the quarterfinals.
The Spartans got two shots off of very early in Tuesday’s contest, but Owatonna’s defense shut them down in the remainder of the first half. Owatonna senior goalkeeper Scarlet Schwartz made back-to-back saves, deflecting the ball and forcing it to go out of bounds and saving a hot after a corner kick.
The Huskies were able to get one shot off in the first half, with Mayo outshooting them 2-1 at the break. It looked like the second half was going to be another defensive battle at the start, but both teams were able to put pressure on the goals and get the ball into the net.
The Spartans started the scoring in the game about ten minutes into the second half. The score was the first shot on goal after the break. They followed it up with a goal 12 minutes later to extend their lead to 2-0.
With about 15 and a half minutes remaining in the game, Owatonna senior Sophia Schlauderaff scored to cut the Spartan’s lead back to one. Freshman Meela Hartman recorded an assist on the goal. The Spartans responded seven minutes later though, scoring to take a 3-1 lead, which ended up being the final score.
Mayo also outshot the Huskies by a two-point margin, as they had seven shots on goal while Owatonna had five. This was just the fifth time all season where the Huskies gave up more than one goal in a game.
On top of the loss, Owatonna had multiple players get injured in the contest, with the game pausing at four different times due to injuries in the second half.
The Spartans will now face the No. 1 seeded Lakeville North Panthers in the section semifinals, the team that Owatonna lost to in the section finals last year.
The Huskies ended their 2025 campaign with a 8-6-2 record. This season’s team had a great mix of upper and lowerclassmen and will see eight seniors graduate this spring: Attley Klemmensen, Sophia Schlauderaff, Gabby Simon, Scarlet Schwartz, Jessica Fisher, Brynn Routh, Rylee Hilmer, and Noelle Kubicek.
